name: Property Core

repository.note: The public repository. Grok clones it only to read the chosen service's guide and these files. It never runs anything from the clone.

services.name: Tour Core
services.choice: Tour Core: self-guided tours for a rental unit

services.name: Cleaner Core
services.choice: Cleaner Core: a cleaner for a property

integrations.name: Property Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the hosted service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the approval page and clicks Allow. Grok cannot approve itself. One connection serves both services.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Grok's built-in Google Calendar connector. Grok reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Grok's built-in Drive connector, for Tour Core's portable backups only.

routines.name: Cleaner Core Check
routines.schedule: Every 5 minutes for a demo, and hourly otherwise.

ships: the bot profile and standing instructions, which name the repository and the hosted address
neverShips: any routine's webhook address or key
live tour, booking, or cleaning records
marketplace.activation: A host adds the bot from the team template link and says Set up Property Core, or pastes the prompt into a new bot. It connects to hostedPropertyCoreUrl/mcp, the host types their invite code from Saad and clicks Allow, then picks Tour Core or Cleaner Core. Each routine is created during setup for the chosen service only. They never run a server.

suggestedPrompts: Set up tours for a rental unit
Set up a cleaner for my property
neverIncluded: any routine's webhook address or key
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
host, cleaner, visitor, or contact phone numbers
live tour, booking, cleaning, message, or photo records
